g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS real-time streaming analytics with Kinesis, Managed Flink and Redshift Serverless

g.title: None.None.Node.25
g.text: Mobile apps write click events to Kinesis Data Streams
The Managed Service for Apache Flink application reads the stream through the interface endpoint
enriches and sessionises the events, and indexes them in OpenSearch for live dashboards
checkpointing its state to S3 through the gateway endpoint
Redshift Serverless streaming ingestion reads the stream into a materialised view
QuickSight queries it over a VPC connection
and writes Parquet files to the S3 event lake, catalogued by a Glue crawler
Analysts query the full history with Athena
